description: In every PA-model, if \(m\ne0\) and \(m,n\) are coprime, there are nonnegative coefficients with \(mu+nv=1+mu'+nv'\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.bezout_model.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  (m n : M) (hm : m ≠ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M)
  (hcop : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.CoprimeModel M m n) :
  ∃ v,
    Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.addValue M (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.mulValue M m (v 0))
        (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.mulValue M n (v 1)) =
      Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.addValue M (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M 1)
        (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.addValue M
          (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.mulValue M m (v 2))
          (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.mulValue M n (v 3)))
